parser_requirement: Extract contract overview, term dates, notice, auto-renew, owner role, source file, source record id.
quality_gate: contract_id must match existing register; overview must be contract-specific and must not contain boilerplate or internal metadata.

parser_requirement: Persist one row per SKU/service/rate/commitment line with quantity, unit, unit price, annual value and evidence source.
quality_gate: sum annual_value_usd must reconcile to contract annual value within approved tolerance or create a disagreement.

parser_requirement: Persist line-level AP history; compute duplicate/off-contract/rate variance only from source rows and active contract coverage.
quality_gate: exception amount must be derived from billed rate, contract rate, quantity, PO and active coverage; never inferred from variance alone.

parser_requirement: Persist PO-line coverage, active contract match and coverage dates.
quality_gate: invoice lines without active matching PO/contract should become off-contract candidates, not confirmed leakage until reviewed.

parser_requirement: Persist monthly SKU usage, entitled quantity, active quantity, utilization and monthly cost.
quality_gate: avoided cost requires usage gap plus reclaim/renewal decision; unused quantity alone is not realized value.

parser_requirement: Persist monthly SLA target, actual attainment, incident counts, credits earned, claimed and received as separate facts.
quality_gate: credits claimed cannot exceed credits earned; credits received cannot exceed credits claimed.

parser_requirement: Persist role/location/rate bands, billed rate, contract rate, hours and amendment reference.
quality_gate: rate variance requires a contract rate and billed rate; missing amendment is a finding only after review.

parser_requirement: Persist quotes, concessions, benchmark references, owners, dates and next actions.
quality_gate: negotiated improvement is planning-grade until a signed agreement exists.

parser_requirement: Persist finance-approved value claims with claim id, amount, basis, owner role and confirmation date.
quality_gate: realized value must be finance-confirmed; missing finance row renders pending, never zero.

parser_requirement: Persist contract-to-application/function relationships and confidence method.
quality_gate: vendor-based inference must be visibly lower confidence than explicit contract or SOW scope.
